model_annotation: The image displays two line plots, each comparing the performance of two models—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—on different training sets: "Easy" and "Hard". Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps", which is linear and ranges from 0 to approximately 1,000, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis in both plots is unlabeled but is linear and ranges from approximately 0 to 1.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. In the top plot ("Easy Training Set"), the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) starts slightly below the red line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) but quickly rises to surpass it, reaching a value of approximately 1.4 by the end of the x-axis. The red line also increases steadily, reaching about 1.35. Both lines exhibit slight oscillations and are accompanied by shaded regions indicating uncertainty or standard deviation. In the bottom plot ("Hard Training Set"), the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) rises initially but then drops sharply to near zero and remains flat for the remainder of the x-axis. In contrast, the red line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) increases steadily throughout, reaching approximately 1.4 by the end, with noticeable fluctuations and a shaded uncertainty region.
